name: Agrippa
summary: A king who came to Caesarea with Bernice to greet Festus and asked to hear Paul for himself. After Paul told his story, Agrippa said Paul had almost persuaded him to become a Christian.

key_moments.title: Lets Paul Speak for Himself
key_moments.description: Agrippa and Bernice entered the hall with great pomp, and Paul was brought in. Agrippa told Paul he was free to speak for himself, and Paul said he was glad to answer before him.

key_moments.title: Almost Persuaded to Be a Christian
key_moments.description: Paul asked King Agrippa if he believed the prophets, saying he knew that he did. Agrippa answered that Paul had almost persuaded him to become a Christian.

key_moments.title: Says Paul Could Have Been Set Free
key_moments.description: Agrippa, Festus and the others agreed that Paul had done nothing worthy of death or chains. Agrippa told Festus that Paul could have been set free if he had not appealed to Caesar.
